Eight independently reset full128MiB address/inverse patterns, all8/16/32/64-bit widths. Each pattern writes and reads the entire address range with NEMU, all4chip highest addresses and exact pin byte counts. Original assembly bodies reused; serial/parallel equivalence and corruption controls accepted.

parallel_full_capacity.scope: Eight independent reset runs, each covering the entire specified address range. Exact accepted assembly bodies, full non-MMIO NEMU checking, original widths/address/inverse patterns. No partitioning of addresses between models. Not a claim of one uninterrupted eight-pattern controller-state sequence.

limits: Finite functional/coverage testing, not arbitrary-input or unbounded formal proof.
RV32E machine-mode CSR/ECALL/MRET subset and cooperative RT-Thread; no asynchronous interrupt, U/S mode, protection or full privileged-ISA claim.
Ideal clocks and functional Flash/PSRAM/SDRAM/ChipLink models; no analog timing, retention, physical FPGA or new-chip signoff.
NVBoard input is controlled on an isolated Xvfb; key-repeat disabled and full Shell prompts awaited. Earlier input-overrun/readiness failures are retained.
NEMU checks every non-MMIO instruction in C5 long memory/application runs; MMIO is independently decoded and synchronized, not two independent device models.
ChipLink retains the original1GiB RTL memory capacity; only the required4KiB range is exercised.
SPI interrupt-completion variant remains optional and unimplemented.
CoreMark single iteration is functional/CRC acceptance, not a certified score; all MicroBench test workloads retain their validators.
